data.body: TDD contract card. Authoritative contract: reasonable-kingsize-polliwog ACs plus cinderlike-weariful-angora real-Git protocol/large-contrast constraints. Preconditions: macOS CI-shaped baseline  passed 9 tests; three workers each paid ~33.23-33.49s setup, pytest wall 78.85s, process real 113.08s. Production path/tier: real pytest integration fixture -> isolated loopback git daemon -> real git fetch/worktree/repack/push subprocesses; a lower tier cannot prove protocol negotiation or pack behavior. Postconditions: size-independent paths use a full-history server below 1 MiB yet filtered fetches negotiate blob:none and omit its historical blob; the >100 MiB full-vs-filtered guard remains real; identity and reconvergence/push behavior remain green. Negative control/defect seed: full small fetch must contain the historical blob, and replacing its small payload with the 141 MiB payload must fail the <1 MiB oracle. Collateral: workflows, named/direct fetch semantics, complete event convergence, and large guard thresholds stay unchanged. Gate: integration pytest command above plus project lint/typecheck/test. Contention exemption: this refactors isolated fixture setup and adds no composed store lock/retry/cache mechanism. Surface census: CLI=IN real git subprocesses; MCP/API=OUT no corresponding operation; public library facade=IN rebar.init_repo through fixture; automated callers=IN parsed standalone/Gerrit workflow fetches; dual direction=IN blobless read plus reconvergence/push. RED: 7 modified/new oracle cases all errored for the intended missing  fixture (3 protocol/size, 2 identity lanes, full-fetch size contrast, reconvergence/push); no import/typo failure.
